title: Agent Skill frontmatter defined by the Agent Skills specification
description: YAML frontmatter of a SKILL.md as published at https://agentskills.io/specification. Six fields are defined and nothing else is allowed; put client-specific values under `metadata`.

name.description: Skill name, matching the directory the skill lives in. 1 to 64 lowercase alphanumeric characters and hyphens, never starting or ending with a hyphen and never with two hyphens in a row.

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it. Non-empty, at most 1024 characters.

license.description: License applied to the skill, either a license name or the name of a bundled license file.

compatibility.description: Environment requirements such as the intended product, required system packages or network access. 1 to 500 characters.

metadata.description: Additional properties the spec does not define, as a map from string keys to string values.

allowed-tools.description: Space-separated string of tools pre-approved to run, such as `Bash(git:*) Read`. Experimental: support varies between agent implementations.
